_comment: Черновые тексты осмотров, подписей и реакций для E0–E1 (M1). Ключи @секция.ключ используются в data/story/rooms/*.json. Все записи draft: true — заменяет владелец текста (ChatGPT с Директором). Обязательные реплики сцен берутся из scenes/*.json и здесь не дублируются. Новых сюжетных фактов нет: только то, что уже есть в сценах, locations.json, items.json и каноне. Поле tags у записи — теги подачи закадрового голоса (pipeline/voice/tags.json, Docs/VOICE_DIRECTION.md: 0–1 тег, не на каждую фразу); в субтитры не попадают. Поле line {speaker, text[, tags]} — реплика персонажа рядом с Агатой (повторный разговор, его слова): показывается как реплика (имя говорящего) и звучит его голосом вместо text; text остаётся запасным закадровым вариантом (убрать line — снова закадровый). Правка в line — только структурная: прямая речь без авторской ремарки (решение Директора 18.10, 01:52).

intro.opening_1.text: Agata is eighteen. She studies in the district town. Back home in Olkhovka, across the river, are Mama and her younger brother.
intro.opening_1._j: J (Р13, Директор 29.10; 18:30 — три карточки на чёрном с озвучкой): вступление новой игры, menu.json → intro.keys; текст одобрен Директором, разбит на три кадра без правки слов

intro.opening_2.text: A year ago, on the night of the flood, the water swept the bridge away. Since then, no one has reached the far bank: send any boat across, and it comes back to its own pier.
intro.opening_2._k: K (ИИ-разбор №15; Директор 01.11, 01:03, утренняя страница): без «будто сама река не пускает» — закон мира говорит обратное (было «…её кружит и приносит назад, будто сама река не пускает»)

intro.opening_3.text: Agata wrote home all year — not a word came back. This autumn the water fell, exposing an old bridge pier. She is going to Aunt Dunya's house in Zarechye: it is as close to home as she can get. She means to find out for herself what happened to Olkhovka.

R1.lantern.use.text: The lantern is in its holder: clean glass, dry wick. Someone has been looking after it.

R1.lantern.look.text: This lantern is used to signal across the water.

R1.instruction.use.text: The board explains how to signal with the lantern and how the far bank should answer. But there hasn't been a single reply in a year.

R1.instruction.paper.text:
After dark, signal from the pier with a lantern.

One flash — go.
Two flashes — stop.
One long flash — raise.
Three flashes — alive: someone is on the bank.

The far bank must repeat the signal in reply.

O1.teacher_drawer.look.text: The teacher's desk drawer bears the school seal.

O1.teacher_drawer.paper_plan.text: To whoever comes through this door. A road is held from both ends. We hold the far end. The near end is the plate on the pier by the bend: underwater, with a crack in it. Dunya has a bracket for it on her workbench. Fasten the rope only to its ring — tying it to the pier's stone won't hold. We tried on our side. Our end runs through the old ring on the far pier. The mill sluice holds back the water; its lever is in the manager's office. Once the rope is fastened, signal three flashes from the pier.

line.speaker: pelageya
line.text: Fyodor Lukich, the mill manager, shut the sluice that evening, before the flood, a year ago. Went home to Olkhovka and stayed there. The water came that night.
line._k27: Директор 01.11, «Семнадцатый заход» (W221): акцент на «домой» не выходил, «снять с САМ» — «домой» в конец оборота. Было: «Сам домой ушёл…»

Z1.tamara.opt_school.text: Who is the school in Olkhovka for?

Z1.tamara.opt_sheet.text: How did you get Dunya's drawing?

Z1.tamara.opt_late.text: I should have come at once.

Z1.tamara.school.text: "One school for both banks. We used to take our children over the bridge," says Tamara. "And now, a whole year with no one to teach them."

line.speaker: tamara
line.text: One school for both banks. We used to take our children over the bridge. And now, a whole year with no one to teach them.

Z1.tamara.sheet.text: "Dunya left it here as she went: send it to the district office, she said. That night came the flood. Here it lies," says Tamara.

line.speaker: tamara
line.text: Dunya left it here as she went: send it to the district office, she said. That night came the flood. Here it lies.

Z1.tamara.late.text: "Don't blame yourself, my dear. You'd have sat by the water all year, like Pelageya. I wrote so you wouldn't come in vain," says Tamara.

line.speaker: tamara
line.text: Don't blame yourself, my dear. You'd have sat by the water all year, like Pelageya. I wrote so you wouldn't come in vain.

H1.wave.label.text: Stand by the stove and wave

H1.wave.look.text: The place by Dunya's stove. Mama can't see or hear me through the glass. But perhaps she has something that remembers this house?

H1.wave.use.text: Mama, it's me. If you can see me at all — I'm here, by Dunya's stove.

line.speaker: agata
line.text: Mama, it's me. If you can see me at all — I'm here, by Dunya's stove.

M1.exit_M2.closed.text: Pavel is in charge here. I won't go in without him. Tomorrow, then.

line.speaker: agata
line.text: Pavel is in charge here. I won't go in without him. Tomorrow, then.

M1.exit_M4.closed.text: I won't meddle with the sluice without Pavel. I'll come tomorrow.

line.speaker: agata
line.text: I won't meddle with the sluice without Pavel. I'll come tomorrow.

H2.hinges_box.empty.text: The "Hinges" box is empty. I've got them — for the school door in the gallery.
